Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: historical Silent Storm softly painted COLOR facial overlay bitmap, not a photograph or new face.

Input1 is the exact ENTIRE native128square source RGBA, with its variable original alpha. Input2 is identical whole original storedRGB NEAREST6x768 source-only enlargement. Keep the COMPLETE full square color bitmap edge-to-edge at EXACT same normalized UV. Only restrained fine source paint, no new anatomy or reconstruction. Preserve original soft blur, every original pigment footprint/position/count/phase, relative weak washes, palette and expression. Original COMPLETE alpha will be independently restored; brightness only one global scalar. Do not invent an alpha cutout or fit/crop individual shapes.

Keep exactly TWO original soft PINK cheek washes (nativeleft22..60,y38..71; right66..105,y38..72), TWO already existing dark eye/halo areas at40..60,y39..52 and66..84,y39..53, and ONE closed softly painted lip wash at53..75,y62..76. Keep original faint blue-violet shading under each dark eye, its muted non-white tint, and all original almost-black gaps. Do not paint eyes/pupils/catchlights or teeth into these dark fields; they are the SAME existing washes only. Preserve the weak tiny reddish source pigment at bottom-left0..8,y120..127, not omitted as irrelevant. The rest is original black color canvas. No nose/forehead/ears/anatomy added. Preserve exactly existing asymmetry and dim lower-lip shade, no new lip shine.

Exact original whole RGB extrema are [[0, 0, 0], [157, 99, 91]]; preserve its muted pigment hierarchy, especially weak fields. No photoanatomy/photofibers/pores/radialpattern/mosaic/newglints/hair/teeth/curls/raised rims or cosmetic glare. No text/logo, hardware, new geometry, local highlighting or sharper edges.

Output the whole source square with same normalized UV, no margins/whitespace/padding/crop/zoom/BBox/rearrangement/sourceRGB artistic repairs. Keep original blur, paint scale, expression and weak source marks. Entire sourceA and default padding restored downstream, not by inventing new alpha.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Whole native storedRGBA to opaqueRGB NEAREST6x only, no crop/BBox/registration/padding/rotate/unpremultiply/sourceartRGB repair. Original fullA separately restored; ENTIRE raw inverse original4x/pure scalar/defaultpad.
